regression_scenarios: Original image-bearing messages retain immutable archives through repeated compactions
Checkpoint unseen-image and hook selections preserve chronology without duplication
Fresh live execution facts replace persisted running-status prose
Index growth promotes to checkpoint once, with one hook and shared two-summary limit
Optional summary failure can require bounded checkpoint promotion; repeated failure stops
Plan/read batches reserve future context in either order; Unicode pages stay contiguous
Provider sizing matches all six wire adapters without aggregate wire-history retention
Consecutive empty Anthropic replies preserve source bookkeeping without empty wire messages
Anthropic model transition resets once; subsequent prompt changes preserve new tool pairs
Malformed provider parts report a bounded error without automatic repair
Invalid writes and rollback never publish provider snapshot cache changes
Provider snapshots are single-session and bounded to 8 MiB serialized payload
Concurrent upgrades wait beyond five seconds, distinguish session ownership, and remain interruptible
Current-schema WAL readers open under an existing write transaction
Durable completion skips redundant barrier; fast mode keeps it
At-capacity closes avoid directory scans and reclaim abandoned active rows
Accounting-only errors preserve complete capture bytes and bound diagnostics
Memory consolidation preserves positional and piped input
Existing catalog, hook, reasoning-selection, and hermetic-environment safeguards remain passing
validation_notes: Linux executable fixture scripts require an explicit exec mount on private /tmp; source stays read-only.
Analyzer runner uses the bundled Linux environment with PyYAML; host Python lacks PyYAML.
Provider fixtures use loopback or fake transports without paid requests.
Capture scan metrics cover admitted-file flushes and close accounting, excluding new-capture admission.
Earlier validation files describe their original source snapshots.
limitations: Existing image archive conflicts and corrupt provider caches are not automatically repaired.
PPC binaries were cross-built and statically verified, not executed.
Host timing/RSS measurements do not establish responsiveness on a 512 MiB G4.
Tiger/HFS+, power-loss, and live-provider acceptance require owner hardware/accounts.
